apis.name: Nominatim
apis.why_notable: OpenStreetMap's official geocoding API; free with usage policy for reverse/forward geocoding and search worldwide.

apis.name: OSRM
apis.why_notable: Open Source Routing Machine; public demo server for car routing, distance matrices, and map matching on OSM data.

apis.name: Open-Meteo Geocoding
apis.why_notable: Free no-key geocoding for place search by name, with coordinates, population, and timezone metadata.

apis.name: ipdata
apis.why_notable: IP geolocation with threat intel, ASN, currency, and timezone; self-serve API with free daily allowance.

apis.name: ipwhois
apis.why_notable: Simple free IP geolocation API returning city, ISP, ASN, and security flags without mandatory signup.

apis.name: BigDataCloud
apis.why_notable: Client-side and server IP geolocation, reverse geocoding, and network info APIs with generous free tiers.

apis.name: GeoJS
apis.why_notable: Lightweight free IP geolocation and country lookup via JSON/JSONP, popular for browser and CDN use.

apis.name: DB-IP
apis.why_notable: IP geolocation API and databases; free lite endpoint plus paid plans for commercial accuracy.

apis.name: IPLocate
apis.why_notable: IP geolocation with privacy detection (VPN/proxy/Tor), ASN, and company data via simple REST API.

apis.name: FreeIPAPI
apis.why_notable: No-key free IP geolocation returning location, timezone, currency, and ISP details for client IP or query.

apis.name: Thunderforest
apis.why_notable: Specialized OSM map tiles (outdoors, cycle, transport) with REST tile URLs and free developer quota.

apis.name: OpenTopomap
apis.why_notable: Free topographic map tile service based on OSM and SRTM elevation, widely used in outdoor apps.

apis.name: Jawg Maps
apis.why_notable: French map platform with geocoding, directions, static maps, and vector tiles on OSM with free tier.

apis.name: TravelTime
apis.why_notable: Isochrone and time-filter APIs for reachability analysis by transport mode, not just point-to-point routing.

apis.name: Valhalla
apis.why_notable: Open-source multimodal routing engine with public instances for route, matrix, isochrone, and elevation.

apis.name: Photon
apis.why_notable: Komoot's OSM geocoder with autocomplete; public photon.komoot.io endpoint used heavily for place search.

apis.name: WorldTimeAPI
apis.why_notable: Free timezone and current-time API by IANA zone or IP, no authentication required.

apis.name: TimeAPI
apis.why_notable: Timezone conversion, current time by coordinate/IP, and DST-aware time arithmetic over HTTP.
